messages:
Priya (CS Lead): FYI — we're seeing a recurring onboarding indexing glitch affecting ~12 trial tenants (EU + NA). Need a short status message we can send to affected customers and a plan for feedback capture.
Jamal (CS Ops): Can you confirm the affected tenant IDs? I'll pull a list and map to AEs.
Priya (CS Lead): Jamal — sending list now (DM). Root cause looks like a transient worker pool rollback during the midnight deploy window. incident-bot: [incident created] INC-2026-0423 - indexing-fallback.
Elena (Solutions): I sketched a concise status note customers can use in-app and email. Want quick review before we send.
Miguel (Account Exec): Please loop me in for tenant ACME-ENG — they're renewal-risk flagged, want proactive outreach.
Ava (Support): Support triage is on it, we've opened tickets and flagged priority. ETA for mitigation steps from infra is ~3 hrs.
Priya (CS Lead): Draft for review: "Hi <Customer>, we experienced an indexing delay affecting ingestion for a subset of accounts. Our engineering team identified a rollback during a deploy and applied a fix; ingestion should resume within 3 hours. We're prioritizing your tenant and will follow up with an RCA and any credits offered." Thoughts?
Elena (Solutions): Suggest adding a one-sentence mitigation customers can try: "If you see missing records, re-trigger the import from the dashboard -> Integrations -> Re-run". Also propose a short form for feedback capture link to collect any data loss notes.
Jamal (CS Ops): +1 to the re-run instruction. For feedback capture, I propose a tiny Google form (3 fields: tenant ID, example record missing, severity) — keeps it lightweight.
Miguel (Account Exec): For ACME-ENG I'll offer an immediate 5% credit and a live troubleshooting session. Priya — ok to promise credit in the message?
Priya (CS Lead): Yes, offer is fine but keep wording conditional: "we may provide account credits after assessing impact". Don't auto-commit.
Ava (Support): I'll paste the ticket template for agents so they collect the 3 feedback fields consistently:
```
Ticket checklist:
- Tenant ID
- When ingestion started failing (approx timestamp)
- Examples of missing items (1-3 examples)
- Business impact note (optional)
```
Jamal (CS Ops): I'll stitch together the final message + form and send to the affected list in 15 mins. Can AEs send personalized notes for flagged renewals?
Miguel (Account Exec): Yes, I'll follow up for flagged accounts and add the credit offer where appropriate.
Elena (Solutions): Also want to schedule a 30-min customer office hours tomorrow for any high-touch troubleshooters. I'll create a calendar invite and a short how-to doc.
Priya (CS Lead): Great. Action items: Jamal sends customer blast + form; Ava ensures support ticket template used; Miguel follows up on flagged renewals; Elena schedules office hours and doc; I'll own the RCA and timeline. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
